services.desc: Curious Theatre’s Student Matinees invite students into the theatre to experience liveperformance and ask bold questions. At the heart of each performance is a simpleinvitation: Let’s Get Curious. Designed for middle and high school groups, these daytime performances connect directly toclassroom learning and real-world issues. Tickets are just $10 per student, with some performances fully subsidized through grantsupport-helping ensure access for as many students as possible.
